items.rationale: Sections 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude translation costs for substantiating a claim, even though the police report itself was required under 2.3.3. No amount is payable.
Sections 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the provider's working materials and surcharges associated with the translation. No amount is payable.

items.description: Robbery settlement for stolen watch and cash
items.rationale: The reported armed robbery away from home is covered under 2.3 and 11.1. Assuming the watch's evidenced value reaches its €2,500 per-item cap, add €500 for the cash under 4.2.3; the €5,000 away-from-home limit does not bind, and the single €50 deductible leaves €2,950.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes forwarding and shipping charges even when billed alongside an indemnifiable property settlement. No amount is payable.
